chapter: Postwar records, Miami and Los Angeles
title: Why no performance is the same
summary: Machito says his band is no machine; "La Paella" played twice would come out differently depending on atmosphere and mood.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: What to think while improvising: wrong notes and being in the moment

blocks.x: He had a nice, a nice band, pretty nice, but it was a completely different style. We was different. Everytime that we start playing, even the same number; we we played "La Paella" right now and fifteen minutes from now, we played "La Paella" again and it is another bash, because depend the atmosphere, the dancer, the way I feel, the way the musicians feel, so this is not a machine or just a computer that you give it one information and they make thousand copy; no my - computer, you going to have a different in-
formation everytime that you push the button.
So that's how you feel about your band, eh?
